status: ADOPTED: the dated pre-run record of P6_M8B_SPEC.md §1.3, committed before any M8b run and before any 2027 data
prepared_by: Claude Code, on Kanav Jaitly's instructions of 2026-10-11 (from the draft p6_m8b_pre_run_draft.json)

sampling_approval.statement: Approved: freeze the M8b sampling plan with seed 20271012 and one event per stratum, subject to the frozen specification and the safeguards.
sampling_approval.scope: freezes the sampling plan only; does not authorize the M8b evaluation before the 2027 ruleset, the pinned 2027 EPA source and the upstream PX-1b/PX-4b prerequisites are satisfied

population: 2027 events whose bracket P6-M1 (C0, results/p6_m1_ruleset_check_2027.json) reproduces, minus the C2 four-member exclusion and the playoff_before_selection_moment leakage exclusion, each counted
strata: TBA event week (payload 'week'; missing -> -1) x qualification-roster size tercile (cuts at the sorted 1/3 and 2/3 positions of the population's team counts), as implemented by _m8_sample
sample_rule: scripts.phase6_playoff_track._m8_sample: per stratum (sorted), all members if at most per_stratum, otherwise random.Random(seed + 100*week + size_tercile).sample(members, per_stratum); members sorted by event key. Fixed here; never changed after a result
recorded_at_run_time: the sampled event keys, the population fingerprint (sha256 of sorted (event key, team count, week)), the eligible-event count and the runtime projection, in results/p6_m8b_dm1_run.json (write-once)
pass_criterion: P6-Q1, P6_M8B_SPEC.md §3 and §6, unchanged: the POINT ESTIMATE of the pooled share of strong alliances (winner and finalist) identified, or missed with a mentor-accepted reason category, must be > 0.5, AND no miss may be unreviewed. The event-bootstrap 95% CI (2,000 resamples, seed 20261010) is REPORTED ONLY: it is not a pass/fail gate, and a wide interval is never presented as proof that performance exceeds 50%

runtime_projection.source: the P6-M8 pre-run record's synthetic engine timing (2026-10-08): 27 s per event at 30 teams, 112 s at 45, 247 s at 60
runtime_projection.interpolation: piecewise linear between the points; linear extrapolation from the nearest segment; at least 1 s per event
runtime_projection.worst_case_basis: the P6-M8 projection's worst case (37.5 min) over its expected (25 min)
runtime_projection.rule: before anything runs, the actual sampled 2027 events' projected worst case must be <= 45 minutes; otherwise M8b stops with nothing run or recorded, and a compliant redesign is proposed (P6-Q13). The seed, strata, count and criteria are never changed silently. The in-run 45-minute abort also stays

sentinel_event_rule: the sampled event with the fewest qualification teams (ties: event key); a far-future playoff result with scouting rows is inserted into the isolated copy, the event is re-run, and every output must be unchanged

reason_categories.definition: The result turned on something that happened after the selection moment, which the frozen leakage rule keeps out of every input: a robot failure, a backup recruited, a lineup change, a card or DQ in the playoffs.
reason_categories.evidence_required: the playoff match records (lineups, a listed backup, cards or DQ) for the alliance

reason_categories.definition: The actual alliance was built around a role Phase 6 cannot measure, such as defense or feeding (P6-Q11/Q12: insufficient_data, zero assumed effect).
reason_categories.evidence_required: a specific, citable account of the role at this event (scouting record, match video), not general belief

reason_categories.definition: A member of the actual alliance had absent or thin selection-moment data (EPA absent, few matches used), so its strength was not observable to any data-driven method.
reason_categories.evidence_required: the record's facts: ordering positions, reliability and presence at the selection moment

reason_categories.definition: The actual alliance resulted from a selection-procedure event the draft model does not simulate: an absent team (T601), a pick-timer skip or automatic assignment (T605; HD-5), or a decline.
reason_categories.evidence_required: the event's selection record or video showing the procedural event

reason_categories.definition: The actual winner or finalist was not a strong alliance by any pre-selection measure: neither baseline identified it either.
reason_categories.evidence_required: raw_epa_draft_hit and actual_seed_order_hit both false in the record's facts for that miss

reason_categories.definition: The event's input data (TBA alliances or matches, EPA) is wrong in a way that changes the outcome.
reason_categories.evidence_required: the specific record and the corrected fact, from an official source

review_rule: Each miss is reviewed by the named mentor, who accepts or rejects exactly one category with its evidence. A miss without an accepted category counts as a miss (P6-Q1). Nothing is accepted by default.

evidence.request: Kanav Jaitly's attestation (2026-10-11): his request that Mr. Biery review every required miss for M8b; the original request text is not in the repository and was not recovered

mentor_agreement.scope: review every miss of the M8b run
mentor_agreement.limitation: scope established by Kanav's attestation of the request, not by the request's own text

not_authorized_by_this_record: any change to the frozen criteria
